publishedCaption:
A short video showing a scuffle inside a cinema has gone viral alongside claims that an argument began after a man allegedly revealed Spider-Man plot details during a screening. Viewers are seen confronting him before a fight breaks out. The exact location, circumstances and claimed cause have not been independently or officially confirmed.

The clip has renewed discussion about cinema etiquette and the harm caused by speaking through or spoiling a film. No reliable report or official authority has confirmed the precise cause, injuries, any formal complaint, or claims that a death occurred.
